worst_moment: "When you subtract a group, you flip every sign inside. Try 8 - (3 - 2) and see what happens. What do you get?" - the same line for the sixth time after the student said 'You're just repeating yourself... Can you actually show me what's wrong?', and it never points out that 7 - (3 + 1) is 3, not 5.
best_moment: "When you subtract a group, you change the sign of every term inside. Try it on 7 - (3 + 1). What do you get?" - a sensible numeric check that could have exposed the error if Sensei had followed up on the student's wrong 5.
